source_boundary: Original authored teaching scenarios aligned to supplied course; not copied assessment questions.

scenarios.title: Food Preparation
scenarios.answer: Use one measure on each stated route; addressing only the board leaves the hand route open.

scenarios.title: Shared Water Station
scenarios.answer: Choose route-specific measures; multiple supported combinations may be valid.

scenarios.title: Indoor Respiratory Case
scenarios.answer: Ventilation and source reduction address the supplied routes; table cleaning alone does not.

scenarios.title: Layered Community Centre
scenarios.answer: Use evidence-supported prevention; antibiotics are treatment for some bacterial infections, not a universal route blocker.

scenarios.title: Body Defence Sequence
scenarios.answer: Immune memory belongs to adaptive immunity; vaccination prepares a response and is not an instant cure.

scenarios.title: Two-Route Transfer
scenarios.answer: Choose two route-matched measures and explain any remaining route. The model does not predict real infection probability.
